title: Page 9
content_zh:
就像昨晚，他简简单单地叫一句阿宁，自己的防线就轻易地被击溃了，而她刚刚之所以那么崩溃，就是恨自己的软弱，为什么就不能好好的教训一下肖崇源呢？
正出神着，就感觉到肖崇源细细碎碎的吻落了下来，温宁侧过头，脸颊蹭过他的皮肤，感觉到一丝丝湿润，他哭了吗？
肖崇源的吻顺势落到她的唇上，在尝出一丝咸湿的时候便松开她，用嘴唇蹭了蹭她泪湿的脸庞，“温宁，我不会再让你流泪了。”
第9章(1)
如果你以为前面就是结局的话，那么你就错了。
那段婚姻带给温宁的创伤虽然不致命，但也确实让她难过了好一阵子，如果轻轻松松就被肖崇源说服去复婚，那她是绝对不甘心的。
不过反过来说，虽然温宁很生气，但她也不会那么冲动地离开，毕竟她还需要和肖崇源假复婚，去找家人要证件资料，几经权衡，温宁决定给彼此一段考虑的时间，当然在这段时间内，肖崇源不会好过。
肖崇源必须做的第一件事，就是履行承诺去替温宁要回证件。
时隔两年再来到温宅，肖崇源竟觉得比新婚时来还要紧张，这一天他们是突然造访，所以温父并不在家，只有温母和三姐温柔在。
“你们破镜重圆，也算是了了我和她爸的一桩心事。”
“妈，这下你们放心了吧？”温宁的心思都拴在自己的证件资料上。
“和妈妈说说，你们是怎么和好的？”温母不急不缓地笑，问出口的话明显是在试探。
“妈！”温宁有些着急。
“我们是几个月前重逢的，阿宁负责的模特儿来我的医院做手术，之后经过接触，我们知道之前有很多事都是误会。”肖崇源替温宁说，语气四平八稳，“不过我们现在并没有正式复婚，但我们决定重新开始，认真地再交往一次。”
温宁闻言诧异地看了肖崇源一眼，他怎么不照剧本来演？他们要复婚才能拿回证件啊！
温宁心里正慌张着，却听温母笑说：“如果你们说已经复婚了，我倒有些不信，原来是正在交往，慎重一点也好，不过……”
温母看了温宁一眼，“既然你也知道阿宁在外面找了份工作，而且还合作过，那么你对阿宁工作的看法是？”
“如果可以复婚，她当然不需要再继续工作。”肖崇源想也不想地说，他轻轻揽住满脸错愕的温宁的肩膀，手上微微用力示意她别说话。
和温母聊了没一会后，就见温柔端着笔记型电脑从楼上下来，电脑是
温柔下楼之后本来想去厨房的，没想到被温母叫住，闻声看过来之后才看到坐在沙发上的两个人，她腾出一只手托了托镜片，点头说：“动作可真快。”说完便端着电脑走了过去。

肖崇源礼貌地笑了笑，“三姐，好久不见。”
温柔没说话，笔记型电脑里却传来了询问声，“阿柔，是谁在说话？”
“自己看。”温柔把笔记型电脑忽然转了过来。
肖崇源看到桌面上开着视讯视窗，而萤幕上的女人正是温宁的二姐温暖。
肖崇源神色一僵，笑容淡了些，“二姐。”
温暖的脸上出现极甘、震惊的神色，惊讶片刻后忽然质问：“这个人渣怎么会来家里？”
温柔适时地又把电脑转了回去，淡声说：“你们聊。”说完看了看温宁，“阿宁，和我上楼一趟。”
温宁知道三姐是要背着肖崇源谈证件的事，乖乖地跟上去。
上楼时，温柔的电脑里一直传来温暖很具代表性的咒骂声，一直惧怕二姐的温宁光是听着都怕。
温柔推了推眼镜，接着“啪”的一声，毫不留情地将电脑合上，温暖的声音再一次戛然而止。
温宁上楼大约半个小时就下楼了，之后也没待多久，就和肖崇源告辞离开。
上车后，肖崇源问：“证件拿到了？”
温宁忍着笑点头，拍了拍自己膝上的包包，“搞定！”
万幸啊，妈和三姐都没看出什么漏洞来，温宁长舒了一口气，眨眨眼又看向肖崇源，面露不悦，“不过你为什么要和妈说我们还没复婚，又说不会让我去工作，要是不工作，我这么努力拿回证件做什么？”
肖崇源轻叹了伸手推了推温宁的额颊，“笨。”一个多月前你来时还跟我势不两立，今天
就复婚不觉得太假了吗，如果只是决定正式交往，那你之前的行为大可归为是在和我闹别扭，至于证件的事……难道你揣测不出她们用证件来逼你和我复婚的理由吗？”
“什么理由啊？”
“因为她们猜到如果我们复婚成功了，以我的性格，是绝对不会允许你去做模特儿的。”
“怪不得！”温宁用拳头捶了手心一下，恍然大悟道：“太阴险了。”
“但我又不能直接说不准你工作，不然你当时不反驳我也太虚假了，所以只能语带保留，说婚后自然不会让你工作，添了几分可信的同时也能让她们放松戒备。”

肖崇源耐心地解释完，接着倾身过去为温宁系上安全带。
两个人的距离忽然拉得很近。
温宁睁大眼睛看着肖崇源的侧脸，问：“你骗人可真有经验。”
肖崇源动作一僵，垂眸看了看她，飞快地在她唇上印上一吻，邪笑道：“放心，以后不会骗你。”
“咕！”温宁满脸不相信。
“多少给点鼓励嘛，我最近可是一直在好好表现。”
“好吧，那我再给你一个表现的机会。”
“什么？”肖崇源表现得像是等待主人丢飞盘的大狗狗。
“我现在要利用这些证件去参加模特儿大赛，你要负责全程指导我。”
这个要求完全颠覆肖崇源的原则！他当初可是完全反对温宁去做模特儿的，但他现在不仅要同意，还要指导？但是为了能让温宁和他复婚……还是不行！
温宁和肖崇源回到公寓后，她鞋还没脱就听肖崇源说：“不行，我不同意。”
温宁翻了个白眼，“我知道，这一路你念了无数遍了。”
肖崇源的火气很旺，“这简直比做模特儿还过分。”
温宁不搭理他，径自走进浴室，“砰”的一声将门关上，将跟上来碎碎念的肖崇源挡在门外。
“模特儿大赛？那你不就要穿着那一点点布料在摄影机前转来转去，让全国人民来欣赏评判吗？阿宁，我告诉你，做模特儿的路有很多，你不能……”
浴室门猛然
“这个……”肖崇源瞬间没话说了。
“你不是说什么都听我的吗？”
“可是……”
“难道你又要像离婚前那样，因为工作的事管我？”

“那也……”
“大赛我一定要参加，指导我是我考验你的条件，做不到那就不及格。”温宁一扬下巴，“复婚的事想都不要想。”
肖崇源又跟上去，“别这么肯定，我们……”
“砰”的一声，卧室的门也在他面前关上，肖崇源揉着鼻子后退了几步，他发誓一定要把公寓里的门板都卸了。
从此刻起一直到入夜，温宁都没有再搭理过肖崇源。
他从一开始在她身后坚决的碎碎念，到没话找话的扯淡，再到可怜兮兮的求饶，都没能让温宁给他好脸色。
一直到睡前，肖崇源用最快的速度洗了澡，趁温宁洗澡的时候冲进她房间，钻进被窝就直挺挺的躺着不肯动了。
content_en:
Just like last night, he simply called An Ning and his defense was easily defeated. The reason why she collapsed just now was because she hated her own weakness. Why couldn't she teach Xiao Chongyuan a lesson?
While he was lost in thought, he felt Xiao Chongyuan's thin kiss. Wen Ning turned his head and rubbed his cheek against his skin, feeling a trace of moisture. Was he crying?
Xiao Chongyuan's kiss fell on her lips smoothly. When he tasted a trace of salty moisture, he let go of her and rubbed his lips against her tear-stained face, "Wen Ning, I won't make you cry anymore."
Chapter 9(1)
If you think that this is the end, you are wrong.
Although the trauma brought by that marriage to Wen Ning was not fatal, it did make her sad for a while. If she was easily persuaded by Xiao Chongyuan to remarry, she would never be willing to accept it.
But on the other hand, although Wen Ning was very angry, she would not leave so impulsively. After all, she still needed to fake a remarriage with Xiao Chongyuan and go to her family to get documents. After weighing several times, Wen Ning decided to give each other some time to think about it. Of course, during this period, Xiao Chongyuan would not be easy.
The first thing Xiao Chongyuan had to do was to fulfill his promise and get Wen Ning's certificate back.
When he came to Wen's house again after two years, Xiao Chongyuan felt even more nervous than when he was newlywed. On this day, they visited unexpectedly, so Wen's father was not at home, only Wen's mother and third sister Wen Wen were there.
"The fact that you are reunited has solved a problem that worried me and her father."
"Mom, are you relieved now?" Wen Ning's mind was tied to his identity documents.
"Tell Mom, how did you reconcile?" Mother Wen smiled unhurriedly, and her words were obviously a test.
"Mom!" Wen Ning was a little anxious.
"We met again a few months ago. The model An Ning was responsible for came to my hospital for surgery. After contacting us, we learned that many things before were misunderstandings." Xiao Chongyuan said for Wen Ning in a calm tone, "However, we are not officially remarried now, but we have decided to start over and date again seriously."
Wen Ning looked at Xiao Chongyuan in surprise when he heard this. Why didn't he act according to the script? They have to remarry to get their documents back!
Wen Ning was panicking when he heard Wen's mother laugh and say, "If you said you were remarried, I wouldn't believe it. It turns out we are dating. It's better to be cautious, but..."
Mother Wen glanced at Wen Ning and said, "Since you also know that An Ning has found a job outside and has cooperated with him, what do you think of An Ning's work?"
"If she can remarry, of course she doesn't need to continue working." Xiao Chongyuan said without thinking. He gently held the shoulders of Wen Ning, whose face was full of astonishment, and used a slight force on his hand to signal her to stop talking.
After chatting with Mother Wen for a while, Wen Wen came downstairs carrying a laptop.
After Wen Wen went downstairs, she originally wanted to go to the kitchen, but she was stopped by Wen's mother. After hearing the sound and looking over, she saw the two people sitting on the sofa. She held up her lens with one hand, nodded and said, "You move really fast." After that, she walked over with the computer.
Xiao Chongyuan smiled politely and said, "Third sister, long time no see."
Rourou said nothing, but a voice came from the laptop asking, "Arou, who is talking?"
"See for yourself." Wenrou suddenly turned the laptop around.
Xiao Chongyuan saw the video window open on the desktop, and the woman on the screen was Wen Ning's second sister Wen Nuan.
Xiao Chongyuan's expression froze and his smile faded, "Second sister."
A very willing and shocked look appeared on Nuan Nuan's face. After a moment of surprise, he suddenly asked: "Why did this scum come to the house?"
Wen Wenwen turned the computer back in time and said quietly: "You guys chat." After saying that, she looked at Wen Ning and said, "An Ning, come upstairs with me."
Wen Ning knew that the third sister was going to discuss evidence behind Xiao Chongyuan’s back.If you have something to do, follow it obediently.
As we went upstairs, Wen Ning's representative curses kept coming from Wen Wen's computer. Wen Ning, who had always been afraid of his second sister, was afraid just listening to it.
She pushed up her glasses gently, then closed the computer with a "pop" without mercy, and the warm voice stopped abruptly again.
Wen Ning went upstairs for about half an hour and then came downstairs. He didn't stay long after that before saying goodbye to Xiao Chongyuan and leaving.
After getting on the bus, Xiao Chongyuan asked: "Did you get the certificate?"
Wen Ning suppressed a smile and nodded, patting the bag on his lap, "Done!"
Fortunately, neither mother nor third sister saw any loopholes. Wen Ning breathed a long sigh of relief, blinked and looked at Xiao Chongyuan again, with a look of displeasure on his face, "But why did you tell mother that we haven't remarried yet, and also said that you wouldn't let me work? If I don't work, why would I work so hard to get my certificate back?"
Xiao Chongyuan sighed softly and stretched out his hand to push Wen Ning's forehead, "Stupid." When you came here more than a month ago, you were at odds with me. Today
Don't you think it's too fake to remarry? If you just decided to officially date, then your previous behavior can be classified as quarreling with me. As for the certificate...can't you guess the reason why they used the certificate to force you to remarry me? "
"What's the reason? "
"Because they guessed that if we successfully remarried, given my personality, I would never allow you to become a model. "
"No wonder! Wen Ning punched his palms with his fist and suddenly realized: "It's too insidious." "
"But I can't directly say that you are not allowed to work, otherwise it would be too false if you didn't refute me at the time, so I can only reserve my words and say that I won't let you work after marriage. It adds a bit of credibility and can make them relax their guard. "
Xiao Chongyuan patiently explained, then leaned over to fasten Wen Ning's seat belt.
The distance between the two people suddenly became very close.
Wen Ning looked at Xiao Chongyuan's profile with wide eyes and asked, "You are really experienced in lying. "
Xiao Chongyuan froze, looked down at her, quickly pressed a kiss on her lips, and said with an evil smile: "Don't worry, I won't lie to you in the future. "
"Goo! "Wen Ning's face was full of disbelief.
"Give me some encouragement, I've been performing well recently. "
"Okay, then I'll give you another chance to show off. "
"What? "Xiao Chongyuan acted like a big dog waiting for its owner to throw a Frisbee.
"I will now use these certificates to participate in the modeling competition, and you will be responsible for guiding me throughout the process. "
This requirement completely subverts Xiao Chongyuan's principles! He was completely opposed to Wen Ning becoming a model at first, but now he not only agrees but also gives guidance? But in order for Wen Ning to remarry him... it still doesn't work!
After Wen Ning and Xiao Chongyuan returned to the apartment, before she even took off her shoes, she heard Xiao Chongyuan say: "No, I don't agree. "
Wen Ning rolled his eyes, "I know, you have read it countless times along the way. "
Xiao Chongyuan was very angry, "This is simply worse than being a model. "
Wen Ning ignored him and walked into the bathroom, slamming the door shut, blocking Xiao Chongyuan who followed him and said something to himself.
"Modeling contest? Then don't you have to wear that little piece of fabric and spin around in front of the camera for the whole country to appreciate and judge? An Ning, let me tell you, there are many ways to be a model, you can't..."
The bathroom door suddenly
"This..." Xiao Chongyuan was speechless for a moment.
"Don't you just listen to me? "
"But..."
"Are you going to take care of me because of work like you did before the divorce? "
"Then..."
"I must participate in the competition. Guiding me is my condition to test you. If you can't do it, you will fail. Wen Ning raised his chin and said, "Don't even think about remarriage." "
Xiao Chongyuan followed again, "Don't be so sure, we..."
With a "bang", the bedroom door also closed in front of him. Xiao Chongyuan rubbed his nose and backed away.After a few steps, he vowed to remove all the door panels in the apartment.
From this moment until nightfall, Wen Ning never spoke to Xiao Chongyuan again.
From his resolute whispers behind her at the beginning, to his nonsense, to his pitiful begging for mercy, Wen Ning failed to make him look good.
Before going to bed, Xiao Chongyuan took a shower as quickly as possible, rushed into Wen Ning's room while she was taking a shower, got into the bed and lay upright, refusing to move.
